snippet.title: Lucipurr - Official Trailer | 2025
snippet.description:
Lucipurr is a multiplayer horror game. Players(1-5) try to disrupt a cult’s ritual aimed at harnessing the captivating power of cats. Meanwhile, another player controls a demonic cat and hunts them down.

Add to wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278260/Lucipurr/
